purpose: Connect an ordinary Japanese/English instruction to edit the actual committed same-case previous output, preserve its lineage, render the new result, and reconcile an authorized local file receipt without resending.

request_contract.japanese_example: 前回の回答の「2+3」を「4+1」に置き換えてください
request_contract.english_example: Replace "4+1" with "2+3" in the previous answer
request_contract.source_gate: Selected previous result must be committed in the same actor/case and its saved ContentPlan, RenderObservation and corresponding case-scoped artifacts must verify exactly.
request_contract.matching: One exact original literal only; absence, repeated matches or overlaps suspend. No surrounding text is reinterpreted and introduced text is not rescanned.
request_contract.artifact: PREVIOUS_OUTPUT_REPLACE_EXACT_V1 binds the parent ResultRecord, ContentPlan, RenderObservation and exact source text hashes. Its DocumentResult retains exact UTF-8 source/output byte spans.
request_contract.immutability: The parent ResultRecord and its prior history remain unchanged. A new result depends on the parent result id, exact parent content-plan/render refs and the new edit-artifact ref.
request_contract.guarantee: USER_PREMISE: the literal edit is user-directed and deterministic; semantic equivalence, factual accuracy, citation validity and output-format suitability are not verified.

producer_consumer: committed calculation output -> ordinary Japanese literal-edit request -> actual same-case ContentPlan and verified render bytes -> unique literal edit artifact -> Core content/render/receipt -> following English literal-edit request consumes the newly committed edited answer
